data.body_html:
Choosing between the Pershing 46 and the Astondoa 40 for your boat charter in Marbella in 2035? Both depart from Puerto Banús, but they offer very different experiences. The Pershing 46 is a sleek, high-performance sports yacht built for speed and style. The Astondoa 40 is a more spacious, family-friendly cruiser with a flybridge and steady ride. This comparison breaks down their specs, prices, and best uses, so you can book the right boat for your day on the Costa del Sol.

Boat Specs at a Glance

Here’s how the two yachts compare side by side:

FeaturePershing 46Astondoa 40
Length14 m12.5 m
Max passengers109

All charters include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and VAT. The Astondoa 40 is part of our Tier A pricing; the Pershing 46 requires a custom quote via WhatsApp.

Performance and Speed

The Pershing 46 is a true performance yacht, hitting 40+ knots with ease. Its deep-V hull and twin diesel engines make it ideal for thrill-seekers who want to feel the wind. The Astondoa 40 is more moderate, cruising comfortably at 20–25 knots. If you plan to cover distance—say, from Puerto Banús to Sotogrande—the Pershing gets you there faster. For a leisurely cruise along the Golden Mile, the Astondoa is perfectly adequate.

Space and Comfort

The Astondoa 40 has a flybridge, offering an upper deck with panoramic views and extra seating—great for sunbathing or socialising. Its cockpit is wide and stable, with a table for snacks. The Pershing 46 is more streamlined, with a sporty cockpit and a smaller interior cabin. For groups wanting to lounge and chat, the Astondoa wins. For a sleek, modern aesthetic, the Pershing stands out.

Best Use Cases

  • Pershing 46: Best for couples or small groups (up to 10) wanting a high-speed adventure, watersports, or a chic Instagram-worthy trip. Ideal for reaching Cala Cortés or Estepona quickly.
  • Astondoa 40: Perfect for families or friends (up to 9) seeking a relaxed day with drinks, snorkelling, and sunbathing. Great for a slow cruise to Cabopino or anchoring near La Concha views.

Price and Value

The Astondoa 40 offers transparent pricing: €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours, all-inclusive. The Pershing 46’s cost depends on duration and season—contact us via WhatsApp for a quote. If you’re on a budget, the Astondoa provides excellent value. For a premium experience, the Pershing’s speed and prestige may justify the higher cost.

Which One to Book in 2035?

Your choice depends on your priority. If you want speed, style, and a sporty vibe, book the Pershing 46. If you prefer space, stability, and a set price, go with the Astondoa 40. Both depart from Puerto Banús and include everything you need. Check our full fleet for more options, or explore all Marbella boat charters to find your perfect match.
